note: Candidate pages and licences were checked. Existing files are labelled separately. No new candidate has been downloaded, topology-tested or accepted as final art.

assets.author: Rico Cilliers
assets.work: Select suitable silhouette; make collision/LOD; match local geology, scale, moss and colour. Original page lists 124K triangles; do not instance the highest detail everywhere.
Check ecological fit, alpha edges, two-sided foliage, wind and distance transitions; not an alpine meadow species by default.
Start with one moderate-resolution variant; inspect branches, needles, transparent overdraw, roots, wind and LOD; do not assume one pine covers all elevation bands.

assets.author: Rob Tuytel
assets.work: Neutral geological base, distinct from damp mossy boulders; confirm physical texture scale, normal convention and roughness.

assets.author: Rob Tuytel
assets.work: Reuse as a comparison sample; local geometry and zoned moss remain necessary. Existing hashes are in pbr-manifest.json.

assets.category: ground, bark, plaster, timber, shingles, snow
assets.work: Choose exact assets against neutral light tests, then record author, file, licence, size and hash. Previous ambientCG downloads were blocked; do not retry blocked endpoints or bypass restrictions.
One timber/stone/plaster house, correct door/person scale, real eaves, balcony, foundation and flower boxes; use verified CC0 PBR. Board 06 not selected.
Approved board 02 to blockout, topology, skin/cloth/hair, rig and walk/jump/riding/swim tests. Do not treat a portrait or AI mesh as a finished game character.
Approved board 03; separately verify anatomy, fur cards, gait and interaction animation. Existing low-poly models remain prototypes.
Approved board 04: pterosaur silhouette, forelimb wings, hind legs, long neck/beak, saddle and membrane rig. A grounded blockout, wing fold and takeoff/landing are required before final sculpt.
Four tree forms with structural variants, shrubs, grasses, wildflowers, roots and leaf litter; apply original ecology masks, local moisture/aspect and gradual tree/meadow limits 3500/4000m.

Approved board 08; few well-placed species, motion and seasonal responses, rather than large generic particle populations.
